name: Bimergen Energy Corporation
summary: Bimergen Energy Corporation (BESS) is an enterprise focused on conceiving, marketing, and managing battery energy storage systems and solar power installations across the United States. Its advanced battery infrastructure provides critical utility services, encompassing frequency stabilization, voltage regulation, and essential backup electricity during power interruptions. The company also possesses a substantial pipeline of prospective ventures, projected to generate approximately 3.6 gigawatts of alternating current capacity. Having formerly operated as Bitech Technologies Corporation, the organization rebranded to Bimergen Energy Corporation in February 2025. Its corporate offices are situated in Newport Beach, California.
